parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. The number of returned resources is less than or equal to the specified number
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量。
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token required to obtain more results. You do not need to specify this parameter in the first call. If a NextToken value is returned by a previous call, more results are available
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the service to which resources belong
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的资源名称必须属于该service
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The qualifier of the service to which resources belong. The qualifier must be aliasName and used together with the serviceName parameter
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的资源名称必须属于该qualifier。qualifier只能是aliasName，且必须和serviceName共同使用
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT format
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算调用请求的调用链ID
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id
